instruction: Candid medium photograph of a cozy indoor living room. In the foreground, the man with glasses (R4) and the Black man in a brown shirt (R5) face each other, smiling warmly as they clasp hands in a friendly greeting. In the background, the man in the gray shirt (R1) stands watching them, while the woman with dreadlocks (R7) is partially visible on the left. The scene is bathed in soft, warm indoor light, enhancing the welcoming atmosphere.
